nanjing-1.name: Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum
nanjing-1.bio: Memorial tomb of Sun Yat-sen at the foot of Purple Mountain's second peak, built between 1926 and 1929.
nanjing-1.notes: Free with a free reservation (WeChat or passport at tourist information centres). Separate Purple Mountain pass not needed for the mausoleum.

nanjing-3.name: City Wall of Nanjing
nanjing-3.bio: Ming-era city wall that took 21 years to build and is the most complete in China, with the Gate of China at its south.
nanjing-3.notes: Price is the Gate of China ticket (guide). ticketUrl BLOCKED: http://www.njcitywall.com (unloaded; unresolved)
nanjing-3.held: no sourced cost: the 50 CNY was the Gate of China (Zhonghua Gate) ticket, a separate spot; wall-wide entry not sourced

nanjing-5.name: Confucius Temple
nanjing-5.bio: Confucius temple and former imperial-examination site on the Qinhuai River, ringed by a busy market district.

nanjing-7.name: Nanjing Museum
nanjing-7.bio: Provincial museum of Jiangsu, one of China's first, with eleven halls of bronzes, silk and a door from the Ming porcelain tower.
nanjing-7.notes: Free per guide. Jade burial suit claim left out of the bio (flagged unsourced elsewhere).

nanjing-9.name: Xuanwu Lake
nanjing-9.bio: City lake of about 444 hectares with five islets joined by arch bridges, beside the Ming wall, with paddle boats.

nanjing-11.name: Zifeng Tower
nanjing-11.bio: Supertall tower in Gulou, 450 m and 89 storeys, with a public observatory on the 72nd floor.
nanjing-11.notes: Guide price '10,000' is clearly an error; no reliable price.

nanjing-13.name: Ruins of the Ming Dynasty Imperial Palace
nanjing-13.bio: Remains of the early Ming palace, called the Forbidden City of Nanjing, with Meridian Gate arches and carved stone bridges.

nanjing-15.name: Qinhuai River
nanjing-15.bio: 110 km tributary of the Yangtze through the city, with a scenic belt of old-town sights, snack stalls and canal boats.

nanjing-17.name: Mochou Lake
nanjing-17.bio: Lake in Mochou Lake Park west of the Qinhuai River, named for the legendary Mochou and set in an old Ming garden.

nanjing-19.name: Great Bao'en Temple Ruins Park
nanjing-19.bio: Ruins park on the site of the Great Bao'en Temple, with a museum and a rebuilt Porcelain Tower with city views.
nanjing-19.notes: Guide: 120, 80 if bought on the website (undated 2019). wiki set to 'Porcelain Tower of Nanjing' because 'Great Bao'en Temple' redirects to it.

nanjing-21.name: Drum Tower
nanjing-21.bio: Ming-era drum tower, rebuilt in the Qing, at the centre of a small park on a roundabout at Gulou station.
nanjing-21.notes: Free per guide. No English Wikipedia article verified.

nanjing-23.name: Qixia Temple
nanjing-23.bio: Buddhist temple on Qixia Mountain whose Thousand Buddha Rock holds 297 niches and 515 statues, 22 km from downtown.

nanjing-25.name: Yuhuatai Scenic Area
nanjing-25.bio: Memorial park south of the old city, best known for the Yuhuatai Martyrs' Cemetery.
nanjing-25.notes: General admission free; some sights inside charge 5-10 (guide).

nanjing-27.name: Meiling Palace
nanjing-27.bio: Villa built in 1934 for Soong Mei-ling on Purple Mountain, restored, with a bookshop and cafe upstairs.

nanjing-29.name: Jiangsu Art Museum
nanjing-29.bio: Jiangsu's provincial art museum, which has a new branch and an old branch.
nanjing-29.notes: Free per guide. ticketUrl unverified: http://www.jsmsg.com/ (did not load).

nanjing-31.name: Gan Family Compound
nanjing-31.bio: Qing-era merchant courtyard house on Zhongshan South Road in the old town, now open to visitors.

nanjing-33.name: Yangtze River Crossing Campaign Victory Memorial Hall
nanjing-33.bio: Museum on the 1949 Communist crossing of the Yangtze and the capture of Nanjing, on Dujiang Road.
nanjing-33.notes: Free per guide. ticketUrl unverified: http://djg.njmuseumadmin.com/ (did not load).

nanjing-35.name: Nanjing Yuejiang Lou
nanjing-35.bio: Tower on Lion Hill overlooking the Yangtze, called one of the best viewpoints in the city.

nanjing-37.name: Nanjing Underwater World
nanjing-37.bio: Aquarium on the south side of Purple Mountain, near the Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum.
nanjing-37.notes: Operator page gives 180, guide 150; operator site suspect (spam title). ticketUrl BLOCKED: http://www.nuww.com.cn/ - check in a browser before use. Price low confidence. Adult 150 per guide (2019); operator site is not usable.

nanjing-39.name: Yangshan Quarry
nanjing-39.bio: Ancient quarry that supplied Ming stone, where three sections of an unfinished giant stele still lie in place.
nanjing-39.notes: Single ticket with the Ming Culture Village theme park, price not found.

nanjing-41.name: Pearl Spring Scenic Area
nanjing-41.bio: Resort area in Pukou with a walkable Great Wall replica, a wildlife park and a cable car.
nanjing-41.notes: General admission 40 (2019 listing); wildlife park, cable car etc. extra. ticketUrl unverified: en.zzqfjq.com.

nanjing-2.name: Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum
nanjing-2.bio: Mausoleum of the Hongwu Emperor, founder of the Ming, with a mile-long sacred way lined with stone camels and elephants.
nanjing-2.notes: 70 area ticket per guide (undated); also covers Plum Blossom Hill etc. ticketUrl unverified: https://zschina.nanjing.gov.cn/ (managing agency homepage, no Xiaoling page).

nanjing-4.name: Nanjing Massacre Memorial Hall
nanjing-4.wiki: Memorial Hall of the Victims in Nanjing Massacre by Japanese Invaders
nanjing-4.bio: Memorial to the 1937 Nanjing Massacre with two partly excavated burial sites, sculptures and a museum.
nanjing-4.notes: Free per guide. Verified wiki is the long article title.

nanjing-6.name: Presidential Palace
nanjing-6.bio: Seat of the Republic of China presidency from 1927 to 1949, now the China Modern History Museum.
nanjing-6.notes: Price 40 from a 2015 guide listing, stale; verify. ticketUrl BLOCKED: http://www.njztf.cn/

nanjing-8.name: Purple Mountain
nanjing-8.bio: Nanjing's highest hill at 448.9 m, home to the tombs of Sun Yat-sen, the Hongwu Emperor and Sun Quan.
nanjing-8.notes: Free with a free reservation; sights inside charge separately (Xiaoling 70, 100 pass for nine parks, cable car 25 one way).

nanjing-10.name: Zhonghua Gate
nanjing-10.bio: Southern gate of the Ming city wall, among the best-preserved gate complexes in the world, with courtyards and an archery range.
nanjing-10.notes: Price 50 per guide (flagged dead link). ticketUrl BLOCKED: http://www.njcitywall.com

nanjing-12.name: Linggu Temple
nanjing-12.bio: Buddhist temple on Purple Mountain, now set in a large park, with Linggu Pagoda beside the temple halls.
nanjing-12.notes: Price weak/low confidence: guides mostly 35, others 15 or part of a 70 package. ticketUrl unverified: https://zschina.nanjing.gov.cn/ (agency homepage).
nanjing-12.held: no sourced cost: only a low-confidence 35 CNY from a non-official aggregator, other guides say 15 or part of a 70 package

nanjing-14.name: Jiangnan Examination Hall
nanjing-14.bio: Largest imperial examination hall in ancient China, near the Confucius Temple, now an examination museum.
nanjing-14.notes: 50 per a government news channel summary; other sources 25-45; low confidence.
nanjing-14.held: no sourced cost: 50 CNY came from an unloaded search summary, other sources say 25-45

nanjing-16.name: Meihuashan
nanjing-16.bio: Plum Blossom Hill on Purple Mountain, planted with about 35,000 plum trees of more than 360 varieties.
nanjing-16.notes: 70 is the Purple Mountain area ticket (Ming Xiaoling, Plum Blossom Hill, Plum Valley Arts Building, Purple Cloud Lake), edit 2025-12.

nanjing-18.name: Zhan Garden
nanjing-18.bio: Classical garden beside the Confucius Temple, first built in the early Ming, with a Taiping museum in its grounds.
nanjing-18.notes: Garden entry not sourced; sources disagree.

nanjing-20.name: Jiming Temple
nanjing-20.bio: Buddhist temple near Xuanwu Lake, one of the oldest in Nanjing and called its most popular temple.
nanjing-20.notes: 10 includes three incense sticks; may rise in peak season (undated guide). ticketUrl BLOCKED: http://www.jimingsi.net/

nanjing-22.name: Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge
nanjing-22.bio: Double-deck road and rail bridge over the Yangtze, the first major one built without foreign help, with socialist sculptures.
nanjing-22.notes: Free inferred (public footpath on road deck), not sourced explicitly; confirm.
nanjing-22.held: no sourced cost: free was inferred, no source states the bridge's access or fee

nanjing-24.name: Qixia Mountain
nanjing-24.bio: Mountain in Qixia District known for autumn maples, with trails linking pavilions, stone formations and a canyon.
nanjing-24.notes: 40 is the guide's Qixia Temple price (2015); low confidence, guides range 20-50.
nanjing-24.held: no sourced cost: the 40 CNY was Qixia Temple's ticket (2015), not the mountain scenic area's

nanjing-26.name: Jiefang Gate
nanjing-26.bio: Gate on the Taicheng section of the city wall, giving access to wall views over Xuanwu Lake and Jiming Temple.

nanjing-28.name: Hongshan Forest Zoo
nanjing-28.bio: Zoo in Xuanwu District covering 68 hectares across the Xiao Hongshan, Da Hongshan and Fangniu Mountain areas.
nanjing-28.notes: 40 from guide (2019), stale; official page shows no price.

nanjing-30.name: Nanjing Municipal Museum
nanjing-30.bio: City museum inside Chaotian Palace, founded in 1978, with entry included in the palace ticket.
nanjing-30.notes: 25 Chaotian Palace ticket (guide 2019). ticketUrl BLOCKED: http://www.njmuseum.com/en is the provincial museum domain; do not use unless a browser shows a Chaotian Palace page.

nanjing-32.name: John Rabe's Former Residence
nanjing-32.bio: Former home of John Rabe, now a museum on his life and the Nanjing International Safety Zone.
nanjing-32.notes: Free per guide; weekend visits by advance booking.

nanjing-34.name: Liji Alley Comfort Station Site
nanjing-34.bio: Former wartime comfort station, one of the largest in Asia, now a museum entered by appointment.
nanjing-34.notes: Free; appointment required a day ahead, children not admitted (guide).

nanjing-36.name: Tomb of Sun Quan
nanjing-36.bio: Tomb of Sun Quan, founder of the Eastern Wu of the Three Kingdoms, on Purple Mountain.

nanjing-38.name: Nanjing Science and Technology Museum
nanjing-38.bio: Science and technology museum on Zixinghua Road in Yuhuatai District, with free admission.

nanjing-40.name: Sifang Contemporary Art Museum
nanjing-40.bio: Contemporary art museum in Pukou designed by Steven Holl, opened in 2013, with an art lake.
nanjing-40.notes: 80 museum plus art lake (lake only 30), guide 2019.
